    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "#1.When are bookings typically made? (Lead time analysis)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "-XnMVIA1dZWT"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Plot lead_time distribution\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['lead_time'], bins=50, kde=False)\n",
        "plt.title('Distribution of Booking Lead Time (Days before arrival)')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Lead Time (days)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Bookings')\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 190
        },
        "id": "-0jr6iX2dcyv",
        "outputId": "f57c399c-41a8-4351-943b-55d6288c80bd"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1000x600 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Calculate average lead time by month\n",
        "avg_lead_time_month = df.groupby('arrival_date_month')['lead_time'].mean()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "j9tPIG2GdyMY"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Months in calendar order\n",
        "months_order = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',\n",
        "                'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']\n",
        "avg_lead_time_month = avg_lead_time_month.reindex(months_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))\n",
        "avg_lead_time_month.plot(kind='bar', color='skyblue')\n",
        "plt.title('Average Lead Time by Arrival Month')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Month')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Average Lead Time (days)')\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 181
        },
        "id": "oeDGIUstd7sf",
        "outputId": "44f102b1-ca60-4a37-80dd-e1f948ebba04"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1200x600 with 1 Axes>"

          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "#2.Length of stay correlation with daily rates"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "uhKCHQukd_wO"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))\n",
        "sns.boxplot(x='total_stay', y='adr', data=df)\n",
        "plt.title('Average Daily Rate (ADR) by Length of Stay (Total Nights)')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Length of Stay (nights)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Average Daily Rate (ADR)')\n",
        "plt.ylim(0, df['adr'].quantile(0.95))  # Limit y-axis to 95th percentile to avoid extreme outliers\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 164
        },
        "id": "1M4Ab20peGal",

        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Correlation coefficient between total_stay and adr"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ApW_VHhYeRtP"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "correlation = df[['total_stay', 'adr']].corr().iloc[0,1]\n",
        "print(f'Correlation between length of stay and ADR: {correlation:.3f}')"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
